newsitem.title: GERMANY: Preussag to raise rolled steel prices.
newsitem.headline: Preussag to raise rolled steel prices.

text.p: Preussag Stahl AG said on Monday it would increase prices for its rolled steel products by between 25 and 50 marks per tonne from January 1, with prices rising on average by 30 marks.

Preussag said in a statement that it was making the price increases because traders and consumers had stopped destocking, the European economy was picking up and world steel demand is expected to rise by five percent next year.
Preussag is Germany's third largest steel producer.
